Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEMCO provides integrated MEP and facilities services that power some of the region’s most ambitious developments. From electrical systems to long-term maintenance, we focus on technical reliability and sustainable performance - supported by an inclusive and skilled team with a passion for engineering excellence.

Why Join Us?

As a Section Manager, you’ll play a vital role in the successful execution of MEP works across complex data center projects. You’ll lead field productivity, manage change effectively, and ensure technical excellence in every phase.

At ALEMCO, we’re about more than just building iconic structures - we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious projects, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us to deliver Project Planning and Controls initiatives that directly shape our business success, from sourcing candidates to enhancing candidate experiences.

About Your Team

You’ll report directly to the Construction Manager, with indirect reporting to the Project Manager, and will lead a team of Site Engineers and Foremen. The section management team ensures quality, safety, productivity, and coordination across MEP disciplines, collaborating closely with planning, QA/QC, procurement, and subcontractors to ensure seamless execution across project zones and disciplines.

Your Role

As a Section Manager, you will:

  • Issue daily/weekly installation plans and report progress.
  • Enforce method statements, risk assessments, and DSTI schedules.
  • Track material deliveries in coordination with Project Engineers.
  • Manage change and drawing/spec distribution.
  • Monitor tools, consumables, KPIs, and labour productivity.
  • Ensure HSE and QA/QC compliance at all times.
  • Work week: Monday to Saturday (standard for project-based roles in the region)

What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years’ experience in MEP construction or infrastructure
  • Strong knowledge of installation sequencing, QA/QC, and HSE
  • Site leadership and technical documentation experience
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills

What We Offer

  • Total package of salary, UAE Employment Visa, Medical Insurance & Annual ticket allowance.
  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE's most iconic projects.
  • A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Ready to Lead?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEMCO and shape the future of infrastructure delivery in the UAE.

Apply today and be part of something extraordinary.

title: BIM Modeler - Civil
description:
Civil BIM Modeler - Design | UAE

Are you a results-driven leader with a proven track record in delivering high-value, mission-critical construction projects?

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who We are?

ALEC Holdings L.L.C - S.O. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises.

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Civil BIM Modeler , you will be responsible for developing and managing BIM models for our construction projects in compliance with ISO19650 and company standards. You will lead the BIM modeling efforts, coordinate with project teams, ensure model accuracy, and support BIM QA/QC processes to deliver quality outputs that meet project requirements.

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities, we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious developments, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us and lead delivery efforts that shape the region’s digital future.

Your Role

  • Review Tender & IFC BIM models, 2D drawings, and asset data issued by consultants in line with ISO19650 standards.
  • Lead BIM modeling for design documents; guide and mentor a team of modelers.
  • Prepare BIM models and generate general arrangement plans, diagrams, sections, elevations, and schedules using Revit.
  • Maintain and optimize BIM models following best industry practices to ensure healthy, coordinated models.
  • Coordinate with BIM and design teams to support modeling from 2D CAD plans and construction documents.
  • Conduct clash detection and support clash avoidance measures.
  • Assist internal and external stakeholders with the development and updating of construction documents.
  • Maintain and apply company/project BIM standards, templates, and content.
  • Update models and drawings based on RFI responses, engineering instructions, and design changes.
  • Identify discrepancies in contract documents and report them promptly.
  • Ensure all work complies with project information standards, BIM Execution Plans, and ALEC BIM implementation standards.
  • Support as-built/redline and handover processes by updating models and extracting accurate drawings.
  • Provide timely and accurate information to site teams and project managers.
  • Follow a Monday to Saturday work schedule consistent with project-based industry norms.

What We’re Looking For

  • Diploma in Architecture or Civil Engineering (3 years).
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience as a BIM Modeler in GCC countries.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Revit and AutoCAD .
  • Advanced knowledge of BIM fundamentals, principles, and workflows.
  • Experience working in a collaborative shared environment.
  • Good written and spoken English.
  • Proficiency with Navisworks and/or Revizto .
  • Advanced skills in MS Office and Adobe Acrobat.

description:
Vaga para Representante | PJ/ Parceria/ Canal de Vendas

Sobre a ZEISS:

Fundada como uma fábrica para mecânica de precisão e óptica na cidade de Jena, Alemanha, em 1846, a Carl Zeiss é hoje um líder mundial nas indústrias óptica e optoeletrônica. Temos escritórios em mais de 30 países e somos representados em mais de 100 países, com centros de produção na Europa, América do Norte, América Central e na Ásia.

Nossa tarefa mais importante é levar os usuários da tecnologia ZEISS a áreas que permaneceram escondidas no passado. Nós somos líderes de mercado na maioria dos campos onde atuamos. Oferecemos um espectro extraordinário de soluções inteligentes e produtos nas áreas de Tecnologia Médica, Tecnologia em Metrologia Industrial e Tecnologia em Microscopia.

Sobre a nossa Divisão Médica:

Oferecemos soluções completas para diagnósticos e tratamentos oftalmológicos, além da avançada tecnologia de radioterapia intraoperatória e soluções de visualização inovadoras para neurocirurgia, odontologia, entre outros. Nosso portfólio possui promissoras tecnologias do futuro que garante aos seus parceiros e clientes confiança e excelência.

Sobre a nossa vaga de Representante Comercial | PJ/Parceria/Canal de Vendas | Divisão de Odontologia (atuação em Rio de Janeiro e Região)

Estamos em busca de Representantes Comerciais apaixonados por inovação e excelência no atendimento ao cliente para se juntarem à nossa equipe na divisão de Odontologia.

Como representante da marca ZEISS, você será responsável por:

- Prospecção Ativa: Identificar e engajar novos clientes, expandindo nossa presença no mercado odontológico.

- Demonstração de Produtos: Apresentar as características e benefícios das nossas Lupas de Magnificação e Microscópios Cirúrgicos.

title: Analista de Planejamento e Remuneração Srº
description:

Já pensou em fazer parte deste time?

Buscamos uma pessoa para aturar como Analista de Planejamento e Remuneração Srº com o objetivo de gestão e controle de despesas e recursos, com foco no planejamento financeiro, elabora previsões financeiras (forecast) e o orçamento anual (budget), garantindo que os custos relacionados a recursos humanos estejam alinhados às metas da organização. Ele também realiza projeções financeiras, antecipando variações e ajustando planos de acordo com as necessidades da empresa.   • Projeções Financeiras: Realizar análises financeiras contínuas para antecipar variações, ajustando planos de acordo com as necessidades da empresa;
  • Gestão de Despesas de RH: Controlar e monitorar os custos associados à remuneração e benefícios, garantindo que estejam em linha com o planejamento orçamentário;
  • Desenvolvimento de Políticas de Remuneração: Criar e revisar políticas de remuneração, assegurando que a estrutura salarial e benefícios oferecidos sejam competitivos no mercado e sustentáveis para a empresa;
  • Análise de Indicadores Financeiros de RH: Acompanhar e analisar indicadores relacionados a custos de pessoal e recursos humanos, como variações orçamentárias, para garantir a eficácia do planejamento financeiro;
  • Análise e Controle de Headcount: Monitorar e analisar o headcount, assegurando que o número de colaboradores esteja de acordo com as metas orçamentárias e operacionais da empresa;
  • Abertura de Solicitações no GOAS (SharePoint): Gerenciar a criação de solicitações no sistema GOAS, assegurando que os fluxos de aprovação e processos estejam alinhados às normas e políticas internas;
  • Gestão de Provisões de PLR e Bônus: Administrar as provisões financeiras destinadas à PLR e bônus, assegurando que esses valores estejam corretamente contabilizados e previstos no orçamento da empresa.

Requisitos Necessários:

  • Graduação em Contabilidade, Administração e ou áreas afins;
  • MS Office, com nível avançado em Excel e Power BI.

Habilidades:

  • Boa comunicação;
  • Capacidade crítica e raciocínio lógico
  • Liderança e disciplina;
  • Resiliência e visão sistêmica;
  • Agilidade para tomada de decisão.

Nossos Valores:

  • Fazemos o que é certo;
  • Temos sucesso como um time;

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEMCO provides integrated MEP and facilities services that power some of the region’s most ambitious developments. From electrical systems to long-term maintenance, we focus on technical reliability and sustainable performance - supported by an inclusive and skilled team with a passion for engineering excellence.

Why Join Us?

As a Site Engineer - MEP, you’ll be instrumental in delivering world-class mechanical, electrical, and plumbing works across dynamic construction environments. You’ll manage daily site operations, uphold quality and safety standards, and ensure technical integrity from planning through execution.

At ALEMCO, we’re about more than just building iconic structures - we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious projects, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us to deliver Project Planning and Controls initiatives that directly shape our business success, from sourcing candidates to enhancing candidate experiences.

  • Managing site documentation: marked-up drawings, progress updates, RFI registers, and more.

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering (or equivalent).
  • Registered as a Civil Engineer (or eligible).
  • Minimum 7 years hands-on site experience in MEP works.
  • Advanced proficiency in Primavera & Microsoft Office Suite .

Ready to Lead?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEMCO and shape the future of infrastructure delivery in the UAE.

Apply today and be part of something extraordinary.

title: Traffic Analyst
description:
Position: Traffic Analyst / Analista de OPEC

Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil - On-site

About SportyNet:

SportyNet, is a comprehensive sports broadcasting platform based in Brazil, delivering over 400 live football matches per year. We have distribution agreements with leading local Pay TV operators and a growing digital presence. We are rapidly becoming Brazil’s most dynamic football broadcaster, the home of Série C, select Série B and Bundesliga matches, regional tournaments, the European League of Football (ELF), and women’s football, with new content and offerings launched regularly.

Role Overview:

As a Traffic Analyst at SportyNet, you will be responsible for ensuring the proper scheduling and execution of the channel’s programming and commercial breaks. This role requires precision, coordination, and strong communication across content, operations, and commercial teams to ensure daily broadcast accuracy and efficiency.

Responsibilities:

EN

  • Ensures the receipt of CRTs and/or other necessary documentation.
  • Performs last-minute operational adjustments as requested by the Programming Coordination team.
  • In collaboration with the transmission coordinator, ensures the execution of the programming instruction (PI) during live events in the event of failures, delays, or emergency changes.
  • Collects and organizes data related to commercial airings.

Requirements:

  • Fluent in both English/Portuguese, with excellent communication skills.
  • Previous experience in Traffic, Broadcast Scheduling, or Media Operations;
  • Familiarity with playout systems and scheduling tools;
  • High attention to detail, reliability, and ability to work under pressure;
  • Strong communication skills and team-oriented mindset;
  • Basic technical understanding of video formats and broadcast standards;
  • Proficiency in Excel and strong organizational skills for managing materials and reports;

Aqui, ativamos marcas com o pé na areia e o coração no lifestyle .

Nosso negócio é conectar grandes ideias a momentos inesquecíveis — do nascer ao pôr do sol.

Você será protagonista na construção de parcerias com marcas e agências que enxergam valor em estar onde o Rio pulsa.

  • Mapear e prospectar novos anunciantes e agências nos segmentos mais estratégicos (moda, bebidas, turismo, entretenimento, tecnologia, saúde, esportes...).

Modalidade PJ - Remuneração a combinar (enviar pretensão salarial) + comissão.

title: Gerente Contábil Sênior
description:
O que buscamos?

Buscamos uma liderança sênior que domine a contabilidade com profundidade e atue com protagonismo no suporte às decisões da empresa, tendo forte interação com áreas pares, garantindo a integridade, conformidade e eficiência das informações financeiras da empresa, sendo agente de transformação na estruturação de processos, sistemas e controles e reestruturações estratégicas, promovendo a padronização e a escalabilidade destes.

Suas principais responsabilidades serão?

• Assinar as demonstrações financeiras da companhia como contador responsável (CRC ativo obrigatório).

• Liderar o processo de fechamento contábil mensal, trimestral e anual, com precisão, pontualidade e compliance, assegurando conformidade com CPCs, IFRS e exigências da SEC.

• Garantir o atendimento às auditorias externas (PCAOB) com alto padrão de qualidade e governança.

• Consolidar as demonstrações financeiras da companhia e preparar os reportes ao controlador internacional conforme regras globais.

• Elaborar e revisar notas explicativas às demonstrações financeiras, com ênfase na Nota 08 – Instrumentos Financeiros e Política de Hedge, abrangendo a contabilização de derivativos, aplicação de hedge accounting (cash flow e fair value hedge), gestão de exposições cambiais e riscos de mercado.

• Atuar como referência técnica em normas contábeis, com domínio em: IFRS 16 – Arrendamentos, CPC 25 – Provisões, Passivos Contingentes e Ativos Contingentes, e CPC 27 – Ativo Imobilizado.

• Liderar a estruturação e manutenção de políticas contábeis e controles internos relacionados às rotinas contábeis.

• Promover a transformação da área contábil, reestruturando processos, times e entregas com foco em compliance, eficiência e escalabilidade.

• Ser protagonista nas interações com áreas pares, promovendo soluções conjuntas e sinergias nos processos de fechamento e reporte.

• Liderar, desenvolver e engajar o time contábil, com foco em performance e entregas confiáveis.

• Contribuir com a implementação e/ou evolução de sistemas ERP, com uso intensivo de SAP (preferencialmente), incluindo histórico de participação em projetos.

• Apoiar a jornada de fortalecimento da governança corporativa e crescimento sustentável da organização, combinando visão estratégica e conhecimento técnico.

Para isso, precisamos que você possua :

• Graduação em Ciências Contábeis, com registro ativo no CRC (obrigatório).

• Pós-graduação em Controladoria, Finanças ou áreas correlatas de Business.

• Inglês avançado, com fluência verbal e escrita para comunicação com auditorias e stakeholders internacionais.

• Desejável: Especialização ou certificação formal em normas internacionais de contabilidade (IFRS).

• Experiência em contabilidade de empresas de capital aberto no Brasil e/ou exterior.

• Desejável vivência em processos de IPO ou ambiente pré-IPO.

• Passagem por Big Four será considerada um diferencial relevante.

• Domínio das normas IFRS e CPCs aplicáveis.

• Vivência com ERP SAP e experiência em implementação ou melhorias de sistemas.

• Perfil de liderança colaborativa, com forte capacidade de comunicação, influência e orientação para soluções.

• Mentalidade de transformação e protagonismo, com atuação técnica sólida e visão estratégica de longo prazo.

Local de Trabalho : Zona Oeste (Rio de Janeiro)

Formato de Trabalho : Presencial

title: Site Manager
description:
Site Manager | UAE

Ready to build what others only imagine? As a Site Manager at ALEC, you’ll turn blueprints into landmarks, managing execution with precision, speed, and impact.

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who We are?

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

title: Technical Engineer - Design
description:
Technical Engineer - Design | UAE

Are you a results-driven leader with a proven track record in delivering high-value, mission-critical construction projects?

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who We are?

ALEC Holdings L.L.C - S.O. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises.

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

In the role of Technical Engineer, you will be responsible for managing a section of the build, ensuring that all designs are executed as per specifications, and any changes are effectively resolved and documented.

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities—we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious developments, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us and lead delivery efforts that shape the region’s digital future.

Your Role

  • Review Tender & IFC documents, 2D drawings, BIM models & asset data in accordance with ISO19650.
  • Identify and resolve conflicting design elements through RFIs, CVIs, and workshops.
  • Oversee civil/infrastructure design deliverables throughout design and construction stages.
  • Support Design Manager in developing key project documentation including Project Execution Plans and QA/QC plans.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary data and proactively mitigate potential constraints.
  • Prepare and manage RFIs/CVIs ensuring clarity and timely responses.
  • Assist in subcontractor coordination, reviewing shop drawings, and ensuring compliance with specifications.
  • Track drawing delivery schedules and support timely document submittals.
  • Liaise with planning teams to update working programmes and address technical queries from site.
  • Support temporary works design including tower cranes, hoists, and formwork systems.

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

Principais atividades:

  • Realizar a gestão de pedidos de faturas de energia;
  • Monitorar sistemas e apoiar nas rotinas operacionais;
  • Interagir com diferentes unidades e interfaces, mantendo boa comunicação e organização.

Requisitos:

  • Estar cursando a partir do 6º período dos cursos de Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia Eletrônica, Engenharia Mecatrônica ou Engenharia de Telecomunicações;
  • Conhecimento do Pacote Office;

Benefícios

  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);

  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Kit office.

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +760 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 33 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 21.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Sales Manager
description:
About the job

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage!

Through systematic one-on-one or group training and empowerment models, rapidly enhance the team's capabilities and ensure the achievement of business goals.
  • System Development and Optimization : Establish and maintain smooth communication channels within and outside the team. Continuously optimize team operational mechanisms based on different stages of business development to strengthen the team’s professional expertise.

  • Process Management and Tracking : Utilize a mature Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) framework to ensure smooth operations at the frontline. Adjust strategies promptly based on business progress to ensure process management meets requirements.
  • Outcome Achievement and Review : Ensure work objectives are achieved successfully. Conduct reviews of work processes, explore more efficient methods, summarize experiences, and accumulate valuable insights for future work.
  • Time Management and Optimization : Clearly define time management priorities for the role and different levels, and optimize personal time management based on actual circumstances.

3. Basic Requirements

  • Management Experience : Has experience in managing sales teams, with outstanding performance in another company over the past year.
  • Team Leadership Methods : Ability to clearly articulate methods for leading teams to success, with proven, replicable experience in overseas markets.
  • Experience Sharing : Actively share work experiences and provide actionable improvement suggestions to help the team quickly enhance their capabilities.
  • Strategic Thinking : Possess a holistic mindset with the ability to clearly plan business and team development pathways. When facing challenges, accurately identify root causes and coordinate between headquarters and various teams to resolve issues swiftly.
  • Focus on Talent Development : Prioritize talent growth, having previously served as a corporate trainer or established a training system within the team.
  • Motivation and Resilience : Demonstrate strong ambition and professionalism, willingness to challenge oneself, and the ability to handle work-related pressure effectively.
  • Language Proficiency : Fluent in English and Portuguese (speaking, listening, reading, and writing), with the ability to adapt to long-term overseas work and travel.

4. Job Highlights

Join us to witness the rapid growth of Meituan's global food delivery business and experience firsthand the industry transformation and growth miracles. You will collaborate with a world-class, diverse team, fostering innovative thinking, expanding your international perspective, and deepening your expertise. This is not just a job—it's an unparalleled opportunity to achieve personal growth, realize your self-worth, and drive global business innovation.

title: Foreman
description:
Foreman – UAE

Are you a hands-on site leader with a strong commitment to quality, safety, and daily execution excellence?

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who We are?

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Foreman, you’ll take frontline responsibility for executing daily site activities safely, efficiently, and to the highest quality standards. You’ll lead your team on the ground, translating technical drawings into action and ensuring work progresses according to project plans.

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building iconic structures, we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner on some of the region’s most ambitious projects, we value reliability, innovation, and our people. Join us to lead high-performing site teams that drive delivery excellence.

About Your Team

You’ll report to the Senior Foreman and work closely with engineers, supervisors, subcontractors, and supporting departments including QA/QC and planning. You’ll lead a small team of operatives and coordinate resources to maintain daily momentum and deliver consistent progress.

Your Role

As a Foreman, you will:

  • Lead daily site activities, ensuring works are delivered safely, on time, and to the required quality.
  • Coordinate labour, materials, and equipment to optimise workflow and minimise downtime.
  • Enforce ALEC safety protocols and foster a culture of compliance and awareness.
  • Read and interpret drawings to ensure correct execution and alignment with design intent.
  • Monitor progress and take corrective action to overcome site-level challenges.
  • Maintain accurate records of progress and workforce deployment.
  • Support and motivate your team, resolve on-site issues, and escalate where required.
  • Contribute to improvements in efficiency, cost control, and construction methods.
  • This is a full-time role following a Monday to Saturday work week typical of site-based positions in our industry.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience : 5+ years in a Foreman or similar site-based supervisory role within the GCC.
  • Technical Knowledge : Practical understanding of construction activities, materials, and sequencing.
  • Leadership : Proven ability to guide and manage small site teams effectively.
  • Communication : Clear verbal and written communication with team members and engineers.
  • Skills : Skilled in site planning, resource coordination, and drawing interpretation.
  • Safety-First Mindset : Strong awareness of HSE principles and site compliance.
  • Tools : Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); First Aider certification preferred.

What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Ready to plan the path to project success?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEC and play a pivotal role in shaping a high-performing team that drives our success.

Apply today and be part of something excellent!

Kindly upload your CV in English.

Who We are?

ALEC Holdings L.L.C - S.O. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Your work will ensure that our designs are clearly communicated, compliant with regulations, and efficiently executed on site.

  • Good understanding of civil and structural design principles and building systems.
  • Strong ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and specifications.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to quality.

Atuar de forma estratégica e analítica nas áreas de Controladoria e Planejamento Financeiro, com foco no monitoramento da performance econômico-financeira. title: Educational Technology Specialist
description:
JOB MISSION:

Provide essential support to educators, and students through faculty, and the IT department in facilitating the effective use of technology for teaching and learning. This includes assisting with the integration of technology into the curriculum, troubleshooting technical issues, and promoting digital literacy among students and faculty to enhance the overall educational experience.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide advanced technical support to teachers and students, assisting with software and hardware issues, troubleshooting, and resolving technical challenges in the classroom and events;
  • Manage and organize digital resources, including educational software, e-books, and online materials, making them readily accessible to educators and students;
  • Facilitate training sessions and workshops for teachers and staff to enhance their digital literacy skills and proficiency with educational technology tools;
  • Assist students in using technology for academic purposes, provide guidance on research and digital projects, and foster responsible digital citizenship;
  • Ensure that classroom technology equipment, such as interactive whiteboards, projectors, and tablets, is properly set up and maintained for instructional use;
  • Collaborate with the IT department to communicate and prioritize technical needs in educational settings, ensuring the seamless functioning of technology resources;
  • Promote digital safety and responsible online behavior among students, guiding them in understanding privacy, cyberbullying prevention, and ethical technology use;
  • Collaborate with educators to integrate technology into lesson plans and curriculum, ensuring that digital tools enhance learning outcomes and align with educational goals;
  • Assist with data entry, management, and analysis related to student performance and digital learning tools, helping educators make data-informed decisions;
  • Ensure that digital resources and technology tools are accessible to all students, including those with disabilities, and provide support in implementing accessibility features;
  • Maintain an inventory of educational technology equipment, track its condition, and coordinate repairs or replacements as needed.

EDUCATION:

Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology is Required. This person does not need to have a teaching degree as all interactions with students will be through the teacher.

LANGUAGE:

English - Fluent

YEARS OF EXPERIENCE:

Between 3 and 5 years

SPECIFIC KNOWLEDGE:

  • Knowledge of K–12 curriculum design, especially IB PYP/MYP/DP frameworks
  • Experience aligning educational technology tools to enhance teaching and learning outcomes
  • Advanced knowledge of Google Workspace for Education Plus
  • Fluency with LMS platforms
  • Proficiency with instructional tools
  • Solid understanding of AI in education
  • Knowledge of coding and robotics platforms used in K–12
  • Experience designing and delivering tech PD
  • Knowledge of adult learning theory and effective faculty onboarding
  • Experience participating in EdTech rollouts, migrations, or pilots

title: Digital Construction Engineer
description:
Digital Construction Engineer - UAE

Are you a tech-savvy professional with a passion for digital innovation in construction? Step into a pivotal role where you’ll drive information management excellence using BIM and shape the future of digital delivery on high-profile projects across the UAE.

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision – laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Digital Construction Engineer, you will be responsible for driving and supporting the implementation of information management processes using Building Information Modelling (BIM) across the lifecycle of a construction project. You will serve as a key liaison between the project management team and external stakeholders (consultants, subcontractors, and clients), ensuring digital deliverables and information workflows align with project and client requirements. While your core focus will be on BIM and data coordination, your scope may also include supporting digital construction technologies such as 3D scanning, drones, field data capture, and robotics. You will play an active role in embedding digital best practices and contributing to the project's digital strategy from planning through handover.

Your Role:

  • Support development and communication of BIM and information requirements.
  • Assist in preparing and maintaining project documentation (BEP, MIDP, EIR, LAP, etc.).
  • Configure and maintain Common Data Environment (CDE) workflows in EDMS platforms.
  • Set up BIM workflows and coordinate 3D models, identifying and resolving clashes.
  • Provide BIM training and guidance to internal departments.
  • Conduct QA/QC checks on models for internal teams and subcontractors.
  • Support digital tendering efforts and contribute to project-level digital reporting.
  • Represent BIM in project coordination and progress meetings.
  • Collaborate on the development of standards, templates, and digital procedures.

What We're looking For

  • Strong understanding of ISO 19650 and BS 1192.
  • Proficiency in BIM authoring tools (e.g., Revit, Tekla, Archicad).
  • Experience in BIM coordination tools (e.g., Navisworks, Revizto).
  • Familiarity with openBIM standards (IFC, COBie) and model checking (e.g., Solibri).
  • Knowledge of CDE platforms (Aconex, BIM 360) and scheduling tools (MS Project, Primavera).
  • Visual programming (Dynamo) and Power BI experience preferred.
  • Understanding of 4D/5D BIM workflows and outputs.
  • Strong communicator with collaborative mindset.
  • Detail-oriented, analytical, and proactive.
  • Resilient under pressure with strong time management.
  • Passionate about digital innovation in construction.

What We Offer

  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE’s most iconic developments
  • A dynamic, collaborative culture focused on innovation and operational excellence
  • Long-term career development in a well-established, growing organization

Ready to elevate your surveying career?

title: Digital Construction Manager
description:
Digital Construction Manager - UAE

Are you a tech-savvy professional with a passion for digital innovation in construction? Step into a pivotal role where you’ll drive information management excellence using BIM and shape the future of digital delivery on high-profile projects across the UAE.

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision – laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

The Digital Construction Manager leads and oversees BIM-based information management on a project, acting as the main point of contact between the project team and external stakeholders (client, consultants, subcontractors). While their focus is on BIM, the role may extend to other digital construction tools like scanning, drones, and robotics.

Your Role:

  • Manage client expectations for BIM and ensure deliverables meet requirements.
  • Develop and maintain information management resources (BIM Execution Plan, EIRs, MIDP, etc.).
  • Set up BIM workflows and manage the project's CDE (Common Data Environment).
  • Lead 3D coordination, clash detection, and issue reporting.
  • Train and support project teams on BIM processes and tools.
  • Ensure QA/QC of BIM models and deliverables.
  • Report on BIM compliance and progress at the project level.
  • Contribute to tender activities and support process development.

What We're looking For

  • Strong knowledge of ISO 19650 and PAS 1192 standards.
  • Proficient in BIM tools (e.g., Revit , Tekla , Navisworks , Revizto , etc.).
  • Familiarity with openBIM standards (IFC, COBie).
  • Experience with CDE platforms (e.g., BIM 360, Aconex).
  • Skills in automation , data validation , and tools like Solibri , Dynamo , and Power BI .
  • Knowledge of 4D/5D modeling and scheduling tools (MS Project, Primavera P6).
  • Strong communicator and team player.
  • Confident, resilient, and organized.
  • Detail-oriented with strong time and pressure management.
  • Passionate about BIM and digital transformation.

What We Offer

  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE’s most iconic developments
  • A dynamic, collaborative culture focused on innovation and operational excellence
  • Long-term career development in a well-established, growing organization

Ready to elevate your surveying career?

Apply now and be part of ALEC’s legacy of excellence. (attach your CV)

Apply now and become a valued part of our growing team!
